scope_summary.value: New central generator facility on the Perry Point VAMC campus behind the Chiller Plant. Four 2.5 MW EPA Tier IV final dual-fuel diesel generators with belly tanks (Final BOD reflects 4 × 2 MW); new paralleling switchgear sized for current and future loads; new main switchgear approximately 2,000A at 5kV per feeder; fuel tank farm sized for 96-hour full-load generator run time plus 10 January days of boiler-plant fuel (~160,000 gal); quick-connect boxes for approximately 13 critical buildings; existing 5kV emergency distribution intercepted, spliced, and rerouted via underground ductbanks and new manholes to the new paralleling switchgear. Demolition of approximately 16 obsolete generators and 23 obsolete fuel tanks plus existing switchgear.

design_codes_and_standards.value: Mission Critical Physical Design Manual for VA Facilities; Maryland regulatory compliance (Clean Air Act / MDE-ARMA Air Quality Permit to Construct; Tank Compliance; Clean Water Act; Waste Compliance; Lead/Asbestos Compliance); Maryland PSC CPCN exemption for Type I generators; MDE-approved Storm Water Management Plan and Sediment & Erosion Control Plan
